description: This file is a PHPUnit test class named LeavePeriodHistoryServiceTest, designed to test the LeavePeriodHistoryService component within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It sets up test data, mocks dependencies, and verifies the correct generation and retrieval of leave period data, including handling of different start dates, leap years, and boundary cases.

classes.name: LeavePeriodHistoryServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing leave period history-related functionalities in the OrangeHRM HR system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up the LeavePeriodService and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDateIsNotSet
methods.description: Verifies that calling getGeneratedLeavePeriodList with null causes a ServiceException.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2012Jan1st
methods.description: Tests leave period list generation when a leave history starts on January 1, 2010, and verifies ranges extend to future years.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2010Jan1st
methods.description: Similar to above; tests generation based on a start date of Jan 1, 2010.

methods.name: xtestGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListForLeapYear
methods.description: A disabled test meant to verify leap year handling, currently skipped.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2010Jan1stAnd2012Jan1st
methods.description: Tests multiple leave period histories and correct extension to future years.

methods.name: xtestGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListCase1
methods.description: Another disabled test case for historical leave period list generation.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodByDate
methods.description: Checks correct retrieval of current leave period for given dates.

methods.description: Helper method to convert an array of LeavePeriod objects to array of date strings.

methods.name: convertLeavePeriodToArray
methods.description: Helper method to convert a single LeavePeriod object to an array of start and end date strings.
